articles.title: Nvidia scandal: What’s next for the US tech company?
articles.summary: Jensen Huang has exited Nvidia and its board after an independent investigation into extramarital affairs, including relationships linked to a suspected Chinese intelligence target and a company executive. The departure of the cofounder of the chipmaking giant wiped hundreds of billions of dollars from its market valuation, while Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress temporarily assumed the top role.
articles.description: What happens next at one of the world's most valuable companies will have repercussions far beyond Silicon Valley.

articles.headline: Israel strikes intensive care at Gaza’s Nasser Hospital
articles.title: Israel strikes intensive care at Gaza’s Nasser Hospital
articles.description: Gaza's Civil Defence says an Israeli strike on Nasser Hospital has killed at least six people.

articles.headline: UK accused of ‘silencing’ pro-Palestine voices through entry bans
articles.title: UK accused of ‘silencing’ pro-Palestine voices through entry bans
articles.description: A Palestinian American activist has been refused entry to the UK to attend his charity’s annual Gaza fundraiser.

articles.headline: Building collapse in Syokimau leaves six people dead and sparks safety concerns
articles.title: Kenyan building collapse near Nairobi kills six people
articles.summary: Six people died after an unfinished eight-storey building collapsed in Syokimau on the outskirts of Nairobi, according to a preliminary report from Nairobi City County emergency teams. The incident followed a similar fatal accident on October 23, prompting renewed calls for stricter construction oversight and improved safety measures from state research bodies and local officials.
articles.description: Five people reportedly survive as emergency crews search for anyone still trapped in the rubble.

articles.headline: Car bomb blast in Moscow wounds former Ukrainian prime minister aide
articles.title: Aide to fugitive Ukrainian ex-PM wounded in latest Moscow car bombing
articles.summary: An explosive device detonated inside a vehicle in Moscow injuring Sergei Zavorotny, who previously served as a press assistant to former Ukrainian leader Mykola Azarov. Russian authorities reported that the seventy-two-year-old victim received hospital treatment following the attack, which occurred shortly after a separate explosion killed a military member in Saint Petersburg amid ongoing cross-border strikes involving Russia and Ukraine that resulted in numerous fatalities.
articles.description: Sergei Zavorotny, now a journalist and commentator, was previously an adviser to Ukrainian ex-prime minister Mykola Azarov.

articles.headline: Paytm parent company One97 Communications receives Reserve Bank of India in-principle approval
articles.title: Paytm gets RBI’s in-principle nod to revive wallet business; shares hit record high
articles.summary: One97 Communications, parent company of Paytm Payments Services, secured an in-principle approval from the Reserve Bank of India to operate prepaid payment instruments and revive its digital wallet business. The decision follows regulatory restrictions imposed on Paytm Payments Bank in 2024, though final authorisation remains contingent upon submitting a system and cybersecurity audit report within six months.
articles.description: Paytm Payments Services ‌will ⁠be able to ⁠offer prepaid payment instruments, including wallets, to customers after receiving the central ​bank’s final ‌authorisation, says company

articles.headline: Shashi Tharoor claims speakers were barred from entry for Bharat Summit
articles.title: Shashi Tharoor alleges 115 Bharat Summit speakers barred entry to India, their visas cancelled
articles.summary: Congress leader Shashi Tharoor alleged that 115 speakers invited to the Bharat Summit in Hyderabad were denied entry into India or had their visas cancelled. The Bharatiya Janata Party criticized the event as an anti-India summit involving forces critical of the country. The controversy overshadowed the two-day gathering, which concludes on Saturday and features international delegates from approximately 70 countries.
articles.description: The senior Congress leader said the summit would also focus on establishing a think tank ‘Our World Institute’, and creating a platform for dialogue and cooperation between the Global South and the Global North

articles.headline: Nvidia board discusses chief executive Jensen Huang following controversy
articles.title: Nvidia shares plunge amid reports board to discuss CEO Huang’s future
articles.summary: Nvidia shares dropped more than eight percent during after-hours trading on Wednesday as media outlets reported that the board of directors scheduled a meeting to evaluate the future of Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang. According to the New York Times, Financial Times, and Wall Street Journal, the discussions follow controversy surrounding an alleged extramarital relationship with an employee and a woman linked to Chinese intelligence. The company did not immediately respond to requests for comment.
articles.description: Chip giant's stock price falls more than 8 percent amid speculation over co-founder's position.

articles.headline: Manchester United appoints Mauricio Pochettino as new manager
articles.title: Mauricio Pochettino announced as new Manchester United manager
articles.summary: Manchester United appointed Mauricio Pochettino as their new manager to replace Michael Carrick following a poor start to the Premier League season. Pochettino will complete his duties with the United States men's national team before taking over at Old Trafford. He becomes the eighth permanent manager since Sir Alex Ferguson retired in 2013, inheriting a squad currently sitting in the relegation zone.
articles.description: Pochettino replaces Michael Carrick, who was sacked after United's disastrous start to the season.

articles.headline: BJP urges Pakistan to hand over Pakistan-occupied Kashmir to India
articles.title: BJP asks Pakistan to hand over PoK, says Kashmir integral part of India
articles.summary: Bharatiya Janata Party spokesperson Shahnawaz Hussain demanded that Pakistan surrender Pakistan-occupied Kashmir to India, maintaining that bilateral relations cannot improve without halting terrorism. Responding to National Conference president Farooq Abdullah's previous remarks supporting bilateral dialogue, Hussain reiterated that Kashmir remains an integral part of India following the abrogation of Article 370 by Prime Minister Narendra Modi's administration.
articles.description: Calling Pakistan a "terror state", he said there could be no improvement in relations with the neighbouring country until it stopped terrorism

articles.headline: Indian stock markets snap three-day rally as Sensex drops 318 points
articles.title: Markets snap 3-day rally; Sensex drops 318 points, Nifty slips below 25,150
articles.summary: Benchmark indices Sensex and Nifty declined on November 13, ending a three-day winning streak after retail inflation surged to 6.09 percent in October, breaching the Reserve Bank of India upper tolerance limit. The BSE Sensex fell 318.56 points to settle at 81,592.45, while the NSE Nifty dropped 155.05 points to 25,144.30, driven by investor concerns over potential interest rate hikes and rising crude prices.
articles.description: This is the first major decline for both the benchmark indices this month.

articles.headline: Nvidia and chief executive face shareholder lawsuit over alleged spy scandal
articles.title: Who is Jensen Huang and how the timeline of spy scandal unfolded
articles.summary: Nvidia Corporation and sixty-three-year-old Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang face a proposed class-action lawsuit filed on November 9, 2026, in a federal court in San Jose, California. Shareholders accuse them of misleading investors by failing to disclose an alleged relationship between Mr. Huang and Alice Huang, a former executive at Singapore-based firm Megaspeed who has been linked to Chinese intelligence. Mr. Huang admitted to infidelity, and Nvidia announced an independent investigation.
articles.description: Former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang admitted to being unfaithful to his wife but did not disclose details about the alleged relationship with Chinese executive Alice Huang.

articles.headline: Pakistan military reports killing 74 fighters during border region raids
articles.title: Pakistan military reports it killed 74 ‘terrorists’ during raids
articles.summary: Pakistan armed forces announced that 74 fighters were killed in multiple security operations across Balochistan and Khyber Pakhtunkhwa provinces near the Afghan border. The military news division stated that 31 fighters died in Balochistan since November 3, while 35 were killed in Mir Ali and eight in Orakzai over two days. President Asif Ali Zardari praised the security forces for their ongoing counter-terrorism efforts.
articles.description: Increased attacks on the border with Afghanistan have caused tensions between the neighbours.

articles.headline: Paytm receives preliminary central bank approval to issue digital wallets
articles.title: India's Paytm gets preliminary RBI nod for wallet licence; shares hit record high
articles.summary: Paytm secured preliminary central bank authorization to issue prepaid payment instruments, including digital wallets, boosting its shares to a record high of 1,960 rupees. This development occurs over two years after the Reserve Bank of India barred Paytm Payments Bank from accepting fresh deposits due to supervisory concerns, enabling the wholly owned subsidiary to potentially restart these services.
articles.description: Paytm Payments Services ‌will ⁠be able to ⁠offer prepaid payment instruments, including wallets, to customers after receiving the central ​bank’s final ‌authorisation, says company

articles.headline: Watch: How a server outage took down Microsoft Teams and Outlook
articles.title: Watch: How a server outage took down Microsoft Teams and Outlook
articles.description: A Microsoft outage is affecting services including Teams, Outlook and AI software Copilot.

articles.headline: Rahul Gandhi challenges Narendra Modi to a public one-on-one debate
articles.title: The PM’s political career will be over if we were to debate: Rahul Gandhi
articles.summary: Lok Sabha Leader of the Opposition Rahul Gandhi repeated his public debate challenge to Prime Minister Narendra Modi on November 13, 2026, claiming during an Instagram session that the Prime Minister would lose office after such an exchange. While Gandhi stated he wants a direct debate without long speeches, Bharatiya Janata Party leaders dismissed the demand, pointing out that parliamentary forums already exist for such discussions.
articles.description: The Prime Minister taps my phone, the Opposition leader says; he is no longer attacking me, Congress leader adds, as there is ‘a little fear’ in his mind

articles.headline: President Droupadi Murmu presents National Sports Awards in New Delhi
articles.title: President Murmu gives away National Sports Awards; Lalremsiami first from Mizoram to receive Arjuna Award
articles.summary: President Droupadi Murmu presented the National Sports Awards at Rashtrapati Bhavan, honoring seventeen athletes with the Arjuna Award without selecting any Khel Ratna recipient this year. Hockey player Lalremsiami became the first sportsperson from Mizoram to receive the Arjuna Award, while several other prominent athletes and coaches were also recognized during the ceremony held on Friday.
articles.description: In all, 17 Arjuna awardees were chosen; no Khel Ratna for first time since 2014; three coaches win Dronacharya award

articles.headline: Democrat Scott Colom wins Mississippi US Senate race
articles.title: Democrat Scott Colom wins closely watched US Senate race in Mississippi
articles.summary: Democrat Scott Colom won the United States Senate contest in Mississippi by defeating Republican incumbent Cindy Hyde-Smith after a week of counting mail-in ballots. Colom will become the first Black senator from the state in more than 140 years. The victory follows broader midterm successes for Democrats who flipped multiple seats previously held by Republicans.
articles.description: The historic victory flips an eighth US Senate seat for Democrats after last week's pivotal midterm election.

articles.headline: El Salvador deploys armed robots to fight gangs in Haiti
articles.title: El Salvador deploys armed robots to fight gangs in Haiti
articles.description: El Salvador’s President Nayib Bukele has released a video showing armed robots during an operation against gangs.

articles.headline: Israeli strikes kill nine in Gaza amid severe flooding
articles.title: Israeli strikes hit medical complex as nine killed across Gaza
articles.summary: Israeli military attacks resulted in at least nine deaths across the Gaza Strip while the United Nations issued urgent appeals for waterproof shelter materials. Heavy rainfall recently submerged tens of thousands of tents for displaced Palestinians. International officials emphasized that humanitarian aid deliveries continue to face severe restrictions and permit delays from Israeli authorities.
articles.description: Nasser Medical Complex in Khan Younis attacked as UN appeals for urgent aid to deal with heavy rains in the enclave.

articles.headline: Protests emerge over the proposed Siang Upper Multipurpose Project in Arunachal Pradesh
articles.title: Why the Siang Upper Multipurpose Project has been contentious | Explained
articles.summary: The planned construction of a dam on the Siang river by the National Hydroelectric Power Corporation has sparked opposition from the Adi community in Arunachal Pradesh, resulting in activist arrests starting in October. Demonstrators subsequently declined a dialogue proposal from the state administration on November 5, maintaining their resistance to the initiative.
articles.description: What does the project promise? Why are Adi community members protesting against the building of the dam? And what is the Government saying?

articles.headline: Reserve Bank of India proposes tightening Liberalised Remittance Scheme limits
articles.title: Why RBI wants to cap select overseas remittances at ₹50 Lakh to save rupees | Explained
articles.summary: The Reserve Bank of India reportedly suggested lowering specific overseas remittance thresholds under the Liberalised Remittance Scheme to curb outbound capital flows. Established under the Foreign Exchange Management Act in two thousand four, the current framework allows resident individuals to transfer up to two hundred fifty thousand dollars annually for purposes such as education and investment.
articles.description: The RBI has reportedly proposed a ₹50 lakh sub-limit within the $250,000 annual Liberalised Remittance Scheme cap to curb dollar outflows and protect the rupee

articles.headline: Congress leader Priyanka Gandhi says Opposition lacks details on delimitation session
articles.title: Opposition not informed about possible Special Parliament session on delimitation: Priyanka Gandhi
articles.summary: Congress Member of Parliament Priyanka Gandhi Vadra stated on November 13, 2026, that opposition parties received no official communication regarding a potential special parliamentary session for the Delimitation Bill. Speaking during a constituency tour in Uttar Pradesh, she criticized the Bharatiya Janata Party for allegedly silencing dissent and undermining constitutional institutions across the country.
articles.description: Regarding the Opposition's protests against the Union government over various issues, the Congress MP alleged that people expressing dissent were being silenced

articles.headline: India plans 500-metre trial dive for deep-ocean submersible in early 2027
articles.title: Deep-ocean submersible Matsya-6000’s 500-m trial dive in early 2027: MoES secretary Srinivasa Kumar Tummala
articles.summary: Ministry of Earth Sciences Secretary Srinivasa Kumar Tummala announced that India will conduct a 500-metre trial dive for the Matsya-6000 deep-ocean submersible in the Bay of Bengal during January and February 2027. Developed under the Samudrayaan Project by the National Institute of Ocean Technology with titanium hull assistance from the Indian Space Research Organisation, the vehicle aims to transport three aquanauts to six thousand metres.
articles.description: Trial dive seen as a significant step towards India’s push to send a crewed vehicle to a depth of 6,000 metres under Samudrayaan Project

articles.headline: Trump defends war against Iran during Veterans Day address
articles.title: Trump defends Iran war in Veterans Day address
articles.summary: United States President Donald Trump defended the ongoing military conflict against Iran on Wednesday at a Veterans Day commemoration held at Arlington National Cemetery near Washington. Speaking before troops and administration officials, the eighty-year-old leader claimed Tehran initiated the hostilities and praised Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth, whose presence sparked controversy after a military sentinel reprimanded visitors for laughing at a sacred site.
articles.description: Mr. Trump said in his remarks that the conflict was started not by Washington but by Tehran, which “has been waging war on America since 1979”

articles.headline: India hosts Shanghai Cooperation Organisation Civilisational Dialogue Forum in Delhi
articles.title: China, Kazakhstan, Iran, others confirm participation in SCO Civilisational Forum, says Gajendra Shekhawat
articles.summary: Union Culture Minister Gajendra Singh Shekhawat announced on November 13, 2026, that 15 countries have confirmed participation in the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation Civilisational Dialogue Forum. Scheduled from November 20 to 22 at Purana Quila in New Delhi, the event will feature Prime Minister Narendra Modi at the inaugural ceremony, with India awaiting a response from Pakistan.
articles.description: Interacting with the media at the Bharat Mandapam in Delhi ahead of the event, Gajendra Shekhawat said he remained “hopeful” that Pakistan would also confirm its participation and attend the forum

articles.headline: CESS study outlines economic reforms for Telangana to reach trillion-dollar goal
articles.title: Structural changes in economy, policy intensification must to achieve Telangana’s economic targets: CESS decadal study
articles.summary: A decadal report published by the Centre for Economic and Social Studies emphasized that Telangana must implement structural economic changes and policy intensifications to achieve a one trillion dollar economy by 2034. Authored by experts including director E. Revathi, the study highlighted declining revenue buoyancy, decreasing central transfers, and a heavy reliance on welfare subsidies, recommending increased investments in human capital development.
articles.description: Development spending tilted heavily towards welfare subsidies and direct income transfers with low expenditure on human capital development, decreasing central transfers to Telangana are a few reasons which impacted the State’s finances

articles.headline: New Zealand defeats India by 244 runs in fourth one-day international
articles.title: Henry and Young shine as New Zealand thrash India by 244 runs
articles.summary: New Zealand defeated India by 244 runs in the fourth one-day international at Mount Maunganui, despite trailing the series. Matt Henry took six wickets and Will Young struck a century, helping the hosts post 333 before bowling India out for 89 runs in 19 overs. New Zealand can no longer win the series but aims to avoid defeat in the final match.
articles.description: New Zealand trail India 2-1 and can no ​longer win the five-match series, but they can level it in Sunday's final game.

articles.headline: West Bengal chief minister orders refund from fake rural housing beneficiaries
articles.title: CM Suvendu asks 12,000 fake rural housing beneficiaries under previous TMC regime to refund money
articles.summary: West Bengal Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari announced that 12,000 fake beneficiaries who allegedly received housing assistance fraudulently under the previous administration must return the funds. Speaking at a press conference, the chief minister stated that a special investigation team will probe the institutional corruption, while the government continues implementing various welfare schemes and development projects across the state.
articles.description: Suvendu Adhikari said a SIT headed by a retired judge has been constituted to probe the institutional corruption that allegedly took place during the previous regime

articles.headline: Spain faces widespread general strike over housing and living costs
articles.title: Clashes erupt in Barcelona after thousands join Spain general strike
articles.summary: Transport and public services across Spain experienced serious disruption on Wednesday during the country's first general strike in fourteen years, called by major unions over affordable housing and the high cost of living. Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez encouraged workers to participate, while opposition leaders criticized the move as political. Electricity usage fell by 7.5 percent.
articles.description: Tens of thousands of people have been taking part in the strike, called by the country's main unions over housing and the high cost of living.

articles.headline: International Olympic Committee criticizes election controversy in Indian Olympic Association
articles.title: Negatively affecting reputation of India's Olympic movement: IOC reacts to IOA election mess
articles.summary: The International Olympic Committee expressed deep disappointment regarding disputes surrounding upcoming Indian Olympic Association elections, warning that ongoing power struggles damage the reputation of the nation's Olympic movement. Indian Olympic Association President P.T. Usha previously alleged manipulation during the panel selection process, prompting calls from international officials for a fair election adhering strictly to the Olympic Charter.
articles.description: Usha remains in contention for a second term as IOA head after being nominated by the Ice Hockey Federation of India for the December 5 General Body meeting in which the body's polls would be held

articles.headline: India faces Pakistan in Under-19 Asia Cup final seeking ninth title
articles.title: Under-19 Asia Cup final: India eyes improved batting, bowling effort against Pakistan
articles.summary: India will face defending champions Pakistan in the Under-19 Asia Cup final in Al Amerat on November 14, 2026, aiming for a record-extending ninth title. While lead performers Aaryavir Sehwag and Ishan Sood have driven the team's campaign, India requires improved batting and bowling support from the rest of the squad to overcome Pakistan.
articles.description: Pakistan had beaten India by 151 runs last year for their second title while the boys in blue will be hunting for their record-extending ninth trophy

articles.headline: CCPA fines Ola ₹10 lakh over misleading pre-ride tipping feature
articles.title: CCPA fines Ola ₹10 lakh over pre-ride tipping feature, orders discontinuation
articles.summary: The Central Consumer Protection Authority penalised ANI Technologies Private Limited, which operates the ride-hailing platform Ola, with ₹10 lakh on November 13, 2026. The authority ruled that the platform's pre-ride tipping and add-on features constituted an unfair trade practice and a dark pattern. Booking data showed these prompts misled consumers into believing extra payments accelerated ride confirmation.
articles.description: The authority found that messages such as ‘Adding a tip might help increase the chances of getting a ride faster’ and ‘Tip now to boost the chances of getting a ride sooner’ created a misleading impression that additional payments could accelerate ride confirmation.

articles.headline: U.S. Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick to testify before Congress
articles.title: U.S. Commerce Secretary Lutnick to testify before Congress on Nvidia: US media
articles.summary: U.S. Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick agreed to voluntarily testify before the Senate Banking Committee regarding the Nvidia scandal. Lawmakers seek clarity on what the administration of President Donald Trump knew about former Nvidia chief Jensen Huang's affair with a woman suspected of spying for China. Committee chairman Tim Scott requested the public hearing following national security concerns.
articles.description: U.S. lawmakers have called for clarity on what the administration of President Donald Trump knew about Nvidia chief Jensen Huang's extramarital affair with a woman suspected of spying for China

articles.headline: BYD launches luxury electric brand Denza in India with two models
articles.title: BYD brings it’s luxury electric brand Denza into India, introduces two models
articles.summary: Chinese electric vehicle manufacturer BYD Company Limited introduced its luxury brand Denza in India by launching the D9 multi-purpose vehicle priced at ₹90 lakh and the Z9 GT sports car at ₹1.57 crore. Bookings began on November 13, 2026, with a ₹10 lakh down payment. Dedicated showrooms will open in Mumbai, Gurugram, Ahmedabad, Bengaluru, Chennai, and Hyderabad.

articles.headline: Pope Leo XIV warns on pressures facing modern families
articles.title: Pope Leo XIV warns on pressures facing modern families
articles.description: Pope Leo XIV has warned that digital technology risks replacing genuine human interaction.

articles.headline: Iran official says Strait of Hormuz will not return to pre-war status
articles.title: Hormuz Strait will ‘never return’ to pre-war status, Iran’s Ghalibaf says
articles.summary: Iran parliament speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf stated in an interview published on Wednesday that the Strait of Hormuz will not revert to its pre-war condition. He noted that Tehran reached an understanding with Oman to oversee the waterway and outlined seven conditions for peace talks with the United States, adding that Iran awaits an official response delivered via a Qatari mediator.
articles.description: Iran's parliament speaker and top negotiator says Tehran is waiting for an official US response to its seven conditions.

articles.headline: Al Jazeera reports on historical efforts to challenge Western media dominance
articles.title: Who gets to tell the world’s news?
articles.summary: Scholars and journalists reflect on historical media initiatives like the Non-Aligned News Agencies Pool, established to counter Western dominance in international reporting. Interviewees including Daya Thussu, Sima Kokotovic, and Nabil Dajani discuss how developing nations sought to establish independent communication networks and a New World Information and Communication Order through platforms like UNESCO and the Non-Aligned Movement.
articles.description: A look back at the Global South's early efforts to challenge Western dominance of international news.

articles.headline: Shashi Tharoor alleges 115 Bharat Summit speakers denied entry visas
articles.title: Shashi Tharoor alleges 115 Bharat Summit speakers barred entry to India, their visas cancelled
articles.summary: Congress MP Shashi Tharoor claimed that 115 speakers invited to the Bharat Summit in Hyderabad faced visa cancellations or entry denials on the instructions of the Union Ministry of Home Affairs. Speaking on November 13, 2026, he criticised the government for stifling critical voices, while the Bharatiya Janata Party condemned the event as an anti-India platform.
articles.description: The senior Congress leader said the summit would also focus on establishing a think tank ‘Our World Institute’, and creating a platform for dialogue and cooperation between the Global South and the Global North

articles.headline: PM Modi inaugurates golden jubilee celebrations of S-VYASA University in Bengaluru
articles.title: Yoga has become a gateway for the world to know India: Prime Minister Narendra Modi
articles.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi arrived at S-VYASA University in Bengaluru on November 13, 2026, to inaugurate the golden jubilee celebrations of Prashanti Kutiram and honour former Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh general secretary H.V. Sheshadri. He stated that yoga had become a gateway for the world to know India, highlighting its growing international recognition and economic reach.
articles.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurates golden jubilee celebrations of Prashanti Kutiram in Bengaluru, attends event marking birth centenary of former RSS general secretary H.V. Sheshadri

articles.title: Scenes show aftermath of horrific Israeli strike on Gaza tents

articles.headline: Pat Cummins denies involvement in the 2018 Australian cricket ball-tampering scandal
articles.title: Australian cricket's sandpapergate is back - and it cuts deep in a 'nation of good sports'
articles.summary: Australian men's cricket captain Pat Cummins rejected allegations from Usman Khawaja's new memoir claiming the entire team knew about the 2018 ball-tampering scheme against South Africa. During a lengthy press conference in Sydney, Cummins denied involvement and criticized the timing of the book. Cricket Australia chief executive Todd Greenberg has ruled out reopening an investigation into the incident.
articles.description: Claims the entire Australian team knew of the 2018 sandpaper cheating plot are dividing the cricket world.

articles.headline: Raj Thackeray accuses BJP of instigating conflict in Maharashtra over Chhath Puja
articles.title: Bhojpuri songs at train stations: Raj accuses BJP of inciting conflict in Maharashtra
articles.summary: Maharashtra Navnirman Sena president Raj Thackeray claimed on November 13, 2026, that the Bharatiya Janata Party is deliberately provoking cultural tensions in Mumbai and Maharashtra around Chhath Puja to influence upcoming elections in Uttar Pradesh. Speaking in Mumbai, he alleged that the ruling party exploits regional divisions because its governance performance fails to secure electoral victories.
articles.description: “The Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) and the toxic social media ecosystem it nurtures are currently making desperate attempts to incite conflict in Mumbai, Maharashtra, by exploiting the issue of Chhath Puja,” says Raj Thackeray

articles.headline: Pope Leo denounces machismo and calls for women to be protected in Peru
articles.title: Pope Leo XIV denounces ‘machismo,’ demands women be protected in emotional return to Peru
articles.summary: During an emotional visit to Peru on Thursday, Pope Leo condemned widespread violence against women and urged that they be respected. Addressing crowds in Lima, the 71-year-old pontiff also instructed bishops to handle clergy abuse cases with truth and justice. The visit follows his recent lung cancer surgery and marks his return to a country where he previously served as a missionary and bishop.
articles.description: Pope Leo called on the influential Catholic hierarchy to be models of unity and communion, and instructed Peruvian bishops to accompany their flocks and respond to victims of clergy sexual abuse with truth and justice

articles.headline: Hyderabad hosts second Bharat Summit featuring global progressive leaders and politicians
articles.title: Bharat Summit takes off in Hyderabad today; Rahul Gandhi to participate in valedictory
articles.summary: The second Bharat Summit commenced in Hyderabad on November 13, 2026, gathering nearly 1,000 delegates from approximately 70 nations to discuss alternative global policies. Supported by the Telangana government under Chief Minister A. Revanth Reddy, the two-day event includes international policymakers and will feature opposition leader Rahul Gandhi during the valedictory session.
articles.description: The gathering assumes significance as the first major international meeting of progressive leaders following electoral outcomes in Brazil, Hungary and Serbia, and comes soon after the United States mid-term elections

articles.headline: Calcutta High Court questions Abhishek Banerjee over judiciary remarks
articles.title: Let him give list of judges with the BJP and who aren't: Calcutta High Court takes exception to Abhishek Banerjee's remarks on judiciary
articles.summary: The Calcutta High Court on Thursday criticized Trinamool Congress Member of Parliament Abhishek Banerjee for televised remarks allegedly casting aspersions on the judiciary. Justice Krishna Rao stated during the hearing that an educated representative could not be treated as a layperson, demanding that the politician provide a list of judges. However, the court confirmed the controversy would not impact his pending petition regarding security cover.
articles.description: Following an alleged attack on his residence in Kalighat in south Kolkata on November 7, a visibly agitated Mr. Banerjee had accused a section of the judiciary, among others, of turning a blind eye to threats to his security.

articles.headline: Spain's prime minister struggles to rally left ahead of election
articles.title: As election nears, Spain's Sanchez struggles to rally disillusioned left
articles.summary: Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez faces widespread voter disillusionment and stagnation in polls as the country prepares for a general election on November 29, 2026. Despite a recent general strike and massive protests over housing crises, critics argue that incumbent policies are inadequate. Observers note that this discontent could empower a conservative and far-right coalition.
articles.description: Interviews and ‌polls suggest that many potential supporters are too furious about the status quo and the perceived failings of Pedro Sanchez incumbent government to oblige

articles.headline: Pakistani security forces kill 74 terrorists during operations in western provinces
articles.title: 74 terrorists killed in multiple operations: Pakistani Army
articles.summary: Pakistani security forces eliminated 74 suspected terrorists during intelligence-based operations conducted between November 3 and 13, 2026, in the Balochistan and Khyber Pakhtunkhwa provinces. According to the Inter-Services Public Relations military media wing, troops engaged multiple hideouts in areas including Quetta, Mir Ali, and Orakzai, recovering substantial quantities of weapons, ammunition, and explosives.
articles.description: The operations were carried out from November 3 onwards in the Kurram area of Quetta district in Balochistan, as well as in Mir Ali and Orakzai areas of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, says military’s media wing

articles.headline: Retatrutide trial shows knee arthritis pain relief for obese patients
articles.title: Experimental GLP-1 drug demonstrates pain relief in people with osteoarthritis during trials
articles.summary: Researchers across the United States, Canada, Australia and the United Kingdom published findings in the New England Journal of Medicine on November 13, 2026, indicating that the pharmaceutical compound retatrutide can alleviate joint discomfort associated with knee conditions. Two phase 3 clinical evaluations involving non-diabetic adults with a body mass index of at least 27 administered the experimental therapy subcutaneously on a weekly schedule to test efficacy.
articles.description: A pooled analysis of the studies found that about two-thirds of participants receiving the drug retatrutide experienced at least a 50% reduction in knee pain, compared with 38% of those receiving a placebo

articles.headline: Jessica pegula advances at WTA Finals as Coco Gauff exits
articles.title: Jessica Pegula wins thrilling contest at WTA Finals, Coco Gauff eliminated
articles.summary: American tennis player Jessica pegula secured a three-set victory against Linda Noskova on Thursday to advance out of her round-robin group at the WTA Finals in Indian Wells. The grueling match lasted two hours and forty-five minutes, ultimately eliminating fellow American Coco Gauff from the season-ending championships. Pegula will next face Mirra Andreeva in the tournament semifinals on Saturday.
articles.description: Pegula's win, in the final group one round-robin match, meant Gauff was knocked out of the season-ending championships.

articles.headline: Low-pressure area forms over southeast Bay of Bengal
articles.title: Low-pressure area forms over Bay of Bengal, likely to intensify into depression by November 15
articles.summary: A low-pressure area has formed over the southeast Bay of Bengal and is expected to intensify into a depression by November 15, 2026, according to the India Meteorological Department. The system developed under the influence of an upper-air cyclonic circulation and is predicted to bring squally weather and strong winds to the Andaman Sea and surrounding regions.
articles.description: The system formed at 5:30 a.m. under the influence of an upper-air cyclonic circulation over the central Andaman Sea and adjoining Andaman and Nicobar Islands, according to the latest weather update

articles.headline: Andhra pradesh plans investment protection act to ease business
articles.title: Andhra to bring in Investment Protection Act to ease doing business, says Naidu
articles.summary: Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu announced on Thursday that Andhra Pradesh will introduce an Investment Protection Act to enhance the ease of doing business during the 31st Confederation of Indian Industry Partnership Summit 2026. Officials expect 303 memorandums of understanding worth 9.89 lakh crore rupees to be signed at the summit. Major upcoming projects include a quantum computer in Amaravati and a Google data centre in Visakhapatnam.
articles.description: 303 MoUs worth ₹9.89 lakh crore will be signed at the CII Partnership Summit, the Chief Minister says

articles.headline: United Nations says over one million people face severe food shortages in Lebanon
articles.title: More than one million people in Lebanon face acute food shortages, UN says
articles.summary: More than one million individuals in Lebanon confront critical food shortages driven by economic collapse and consecutive conflicts, according to United Nations agencies and the Ministry of Agriculture. Officials warned that food scarcity will likely worsen as household budgets remain strained. The ongoing crisis compounds years of financial turmoil and the aftermath of devastating warfare since October 2023.
articles.description: UN warns hunger crisis affecting almost quarter of Lebanon's population could escalate without 'urgent action'.

articles.headline: Mohit Yadav wins bronze at Commonwealth Karate Championship
articles.title: Mohit Yadav Wins Bronze at Commonwealth Karate Championship in Glasgow
articles.summary: Karate player Mohit Yadav won two bronze medals at international championships within a single week. He secured a bronze medal in the Elite Team Kumite event at the Commonwealth Karate Championship held in Glasgow, Scotland, from November 5 to 8, 2026. He also won a bronze medal in the senior category at the Central England Open International Karate Championships.
articles.description: Mohit has been a regular member of the Indian team in the Team Kumite event for the last four years

articles.headline: Ireland fears subsea cables face growing threat from malign actors
articles.title: ‘Malign actors’: Ireland fears Russia could threaten undersea cables
articles.summary: Ireland faces heightened vulnerability regarding transatlantic subsea cables passing through its waters, which connect North America with Europe and support major technology multinationals. According to the Irish government, increased presence of Russian vessels and the shadow fleet near critical infrastructure has raised sabotage concerns. Former officials and politicians emphasize the need for stronger national defense capabilities and international cooperation to protect vital digital networks.
articles.description: Home to many US tech multinationals, Ireland raises alarm over Russia's so-called shadow fleet.

articles.headline: Former Indian Vice-President Jagdeep Dhankhar admitted to AIIMS in Delhi
articles.title: All you need to know about Jagdeep Dhankhar: 5 key facts about India’s 14th Vice-President
articles.summary: Former Vice-President and Rajya Sabha Chairman Jagdeep Dhankhar was admitted to the All India Institute of Medical Sciences in New Delhi on November 11, 2026, after losing consciousness during a morning walk. Sources reported that the 75-year-old leader is receiving treatment in the cardio-neuro centre. His hospitalization follows his abrupt resignation from office in July 2025 citing health reasons.
articles.description: Jagdeep Dhankhar was born in 1951 in Rajasthan’s Jhunjhunu district, a physics graduate, he subsequently pursued a career in law

articles.headline: Russian ambassador to the United States Alexander Darchiev dies at 66
articles.title: Russia’s ambassador to US, Alexander Darchiev, dies at 66
articles.summary: Alexander Darchiev, Russia's ambassador to the United States, died unexpectedly at the age of sixty-six, according to an announcement by the Russian Foreign Ministry. Moscow stated that he passed away suddenly on Wednesday, roughly eighteen months after taking up the Washington posting. Darchiev previously served as ambassador to Canada and headed the ministry's North America department during a career spanning several decades in international diplomacy.
articles.description: Moscow announces the veteran diplomat's sudden passing without further details.

articles.headline: Himalayan towns face severe civic challenges due to rapid urban growth
articles.title: Why Himalayan towns need a different kind of development | Explained
articles.summary: The Indian Himalayan Range experienced a decadal urban growth rate exceeding forty percent between 2011 and 2021. Despite this rapid expansion, municipal authorities in cities such as Srinagar, Guwahati, Shillong, and Shimla struggle severely with sanitation, solid waste management, and water supply. Planning institutions frequently fail because they adopt unsuitable models from the plains, while city governments face staff shortages reaching seventy-five percent.
articles.description: Do cities along the Indian Himalayan Range have adequate funds and resources to manage civic issues?

articles.headline: Russia-Ukraine peace talks in Abu Dhabi conclude without major breakthrough
articles.title: Russia-Ukraine talks turn to post-war security but end without breakthrough
articles.summary: Trilateral negotiations between Russia, Ukraine, and the US in Abu Dhabi ended without a breakthrough regarding the five-year war. While officials noted some momentum, deep distrust remains over territorial disputes in Donetsk and European security architecture. US negotiators plan further meetings in Moscow and Dublin to discuss a potential framework for future regional peace.
articles.description: Talks in Abu Dhabi centred around Europe's security framework, with US envoys due to meet Putin and Zelensky on Thursday.

articles.headline: Historic Lavi Fair opens in Rampur with traditional trade and culture
articles.title: Rampur’s Lavi Fair: Storytelling through 300 years of Himalayan trade and tradition
articles.summary: The annual Lavi Fair in Rampur Bushahr, Himachal Pradesh, runs through November with trading grounds offering textiles, dry fruits, and Chamurthi horses. Originating from a 17th-century treaty, the event generates substantial revenue primarily allocated to local cultural programs. Deputy Commissioner of Police Anupam Kashyap and officials emphasize the fair's enduring role in celebrating Himalayan heritage and supporting small-scale women entrepreneurs.
articles.description: Rampur Bushahr’s Lavi Fair in Himachal Pradesh traces a Himalayan journey from wool and barter to women entrepreneurs and digital payments

articles.headline: Passenger van crash in northern Pakistan river leaves eleven people dead
articles.title: Passenger van plunges into river in northern Pakistan, killing 11 people
articles.summary: A passenger van veered off a mountain road and plunged into a river in northern Pakistan on November 12, 2026, resulting in the deaths of eleven people and injuries to three others. Local police official Mohammad Afzal confirmed the incident occurred in the Gilgit-Baltistan region after the driver lost control. Regional Chief Minister Amjad Hussain expressed deep sorrow as rescue teams transferred all victims to a nearby hospital.
articles.description: Officials say a passenger van veered off a mountainous road and plunged into a river in northern Pakistan, killing 11 people and injuring three others

articles.headline: Dutch government faces instability following tax plan dispute
articles.title: How did a tax proposal lead the Dutch government to the verge of collapse? | Explained
articles.summary: The Netherlands' three-party minority coalition is facing potential collapse after internal disagreements over the 2027 Tax Plan. Although the House of Representatives passed the legislation on November 12, 2026, and the government survived a no-confidence vote, the rift threatens Prime Minister Rob Jetten's administration just nine months into its four-year term following previous political instability.
articles.description: The Netherlands currently has a minority government by a coalition of three parties holding 66 seats in the 150-member Tweede Kamer, the lower house

articles.headline: Bandh partially disrupts normal life in Manipur district over woman killing
articles.title: Normal life hit partially due to bandh in Manipur’s Kangpokpi district over killing of woman
articles.summary: Normal life was partially disrupted in Manipur's Kangpokpi district on November 13, 2026, as a forty-eight-hour shutdown called by the Committee on Tribal Unity closed markets and kept public transport off the roads. The protest followed the death of a forty-two-year-old Kuki woman who was shot during a gunfight near Taphou Kuki village on November 12, prompting demands for the withdrawal of specific security forces from the area.
articles.description: Kangpokpi-based Committee on Tribal Unity called the 48-hour shutdown from November 12 midnight, following the gunfight in the vicinity of Taphou Kuki village

articles.headline: Bihar government issues ration cards to millions of new beneficiaries
articles.title: Bihar government issues ration cards to nearly 24 lakh new beneficiaries
articles.summary: The government of Bihar distributed ration cards to 23.75 lakh new beneficiaries on November 12, 2026, as part of a welfare initiative led by Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary. Officials also granted licenses for 1,448 new Public Distribution System shops in Patna. The administration aims to add one crore new ration card holders this financial year to ensure food security.
articles.description: Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary has set the target to add one crore new ration card holders this financial year

articles.headline: Researchers identify unique microbial signature in Chennai transit system
articles.title: Swabbing public transport to identify urban microbiomes, a city’s microbial signature
articles.summary: Researchers from the Indian Institute of Technology Madras collected 96 samples from 12 stations and trains across Chennai Metro Rail lines between December 2021 and January 2022. Following whole-genome metagenomic sequencing of 47 quality-controlled samples from high-touch surfaces, the team discovered that Chennai possesses a distinctive transit biome shaped by local climate, humidity, urban density, and nearby agricultural activity.
articles.description: A recent study in the Chennai Metro Rail showed a wide range of microbes found on high-touch surfaces, though researchers said there was no cause for fear and no immediate reason to act

articles.headline: England beats Croatia to reach Nations League quarterfinals
articles.title: Harry Kane breaks caps record as England reach Nations League knockouts
articles.summary: Captain Harry Kane celebrated his record-breaking 126th appearance by scoring a penalty in England's 2-1 victory over Croatia at Wembley Stadium on Thursday. The win secures Thomas Tuchel's team a place in the Nations League quarterfinals in March. Morgan Rogers also scored for England before Petar Sucic equalised for the visitors.
articles.description: England moved to second spot in Group A3 behind Spain, confirming their place in the Nations League last eight in March.

articles.headline: India extends ban on Zakir Naik's Islamic Research Foundation
articles.title: MHA declares Zakir Naik’s Islamic Research Foundation unlawful for another five years
articles.summary: The Ministry of Home Affairs declared Zakir Naik's Islamic Research Foundation an unlawful association under the Unlawful Activities Prevention Act for an additional five years. Authorities stated the measure aims to prevent subversive activities, communal disharmony, and threats to national sovereignty. Naik remains abroad and faces ongoing investigations by the National Investigation Agency.
articles.description: This is the third time that the ban against IRF has been extended. The outfit was first banned in 2016

articles.headline: Militants ambush police vehicles in northwestern Pakistan, killing 10 officers
articles.title: Militants ambush police vehicles in northwestern Pakistan, killing at least 10 officers
articles.summary: Ten police officers were killed in a militant ambush on Wednesday in Kohat, a district within Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province in northwestern Pakistan. Local police official Faisal Khan confirmed two senior officers were among the fatalities during the ongoing gunbattle. The Pakistani Taliban subsequently claimed responsibility for the assault. The region has experienced a surge in violence attributed to the group, which operates near the Afghan border and shares close ties with the Afghan Taliban.
articles.description: Police say militants have ambushed vehicles carrying police officers in northwestern Pakistan, triggering a gunbattle that killed at least 10 officers

articles.headline: Democratic Republic of Congo Ebola outbreak exceeds 11,000 confirmed cases
articles.title: DR Congo Ebola outbreak exceeds 11,000 cases, causes 5,387 deaths
articles.summary: The Democratic Republic of Congo has recorded over 11,000 confirmed Ebola cases and 5,387 deaths during its 17th outbreak, according to the National Institute of Public Health. Armed conflict continues to severely hamper the medical response across affected regions. Health authorities reported that youths recently set fire to an Ebola treatment centre in Ituri province. The ongoing instability and militia clashes have repeatedly disrupted health operations and suspended emergency containment efforts throughout northeastern areas.
articles.description: The 17th outbreak of the virus in the DRC's history was officially declared in May, but experts believe it emerged weeks or even months earlier

articles.headline: Congress criticises Adani Green Energy over Maharashtra project cost revision
articles.title: ‘Scandal of gigantic proportions’: Congress on Adani slashing Maharashtra power project cost by 99%
articles.summary: The Indian National Congress denounced Adani Green Energy Limited on November 13, 2026, for allegedly reducing its Satara district hydropower project cost from 5,675 crore rupees to 56.75 crore rupees. Jairam Ramesh condemned the 99 percent reduction as a massive scandal and reiterated demands for a Joint Parliamentary Committee investigation into the conglomerate's operations.
articles.description: Adani Green Energy Limited has sought to sharply revise the cost of its 1,500 megawatt hydropower project in Maharashtra's Satara district downwards to ₹56.75 crore from ₹5,675 crore, a newspaper report said

articles.headline: Leaders at COP31 urge climate action despite global conflicts
articles.title: COP31 leaders urge focus on climate action despite global conflicts
articles.summary: The presidents of Brazil and Turkey warned at the COP31 climate conference that global conflicts and trade disputes must not derail international efforts to combat global warming. Speaking on November 11, 2026, leaders emphasized the urgent need for clean energy adoption as delegates negotiate new agreements to address escalating extreme weather events and rising global temperatures.
articles.description: Negotiators from nearly 200 countries are seeking agreement at COP31 on a proposal from Turkey to increase the share of electricity in global ‌energy use and revive stalled efforts to move away from fossil fuels

articles.headline: Ladakh administration announces upcoming hill council, panchayat and municipal elections
articles.title: Why Ladakh polls announcement fails to cut ice with protesting civil society groups | Explained
articles.summary: The Lieutenant Governor-led administration of Ladakh has announced three-tier local elections across the Union Territory, with panchayat and municipal polls slated for November 21 and hill council elections scheduled for December 4. These upcoming polls provide critical platforms for public representatives in the region. However, the short timeline established by the State Election Commission creates difficulties for political parties to campaign and form alliances.
articles.description: LAB and KDA are demanding postponement of hill council elections to April-May next year, citing unfavourable winter timing and lack of consultation

articles.headline: United States Senate Republicans re-elect John Thune as party leader
articles.title: John Thune re-elected as US Senate Republican leader after midterm losses
articles.summary: United States Senate Republicans re-elected South Dakota lawmaker John Thune to lead their conference during a closed-door meeting at the Capitol on Tuesday. Thune ran unopposed despite recent midterm losses that saw the party lose at least seven Senate seats. He stated that the electoral backlash stemmed largely from the high cost of living for American people. Thune will now prepare to work alongside a Democratic-controlled Congress and a White House aiming to advance its controversial policies.
articles.description: The Republican ran unopposed, despite some GOP lawmaker demands to evaluate the party's stinging midterm losses to Democ

articles.headline: US charges three operatives over Iran-backed terror plots in Europe and America
articles.title: Three Iran-backed suspects plotted attacks including RAF Fairford incident, US says
articles.summary: The United States Department of Justice unsealed an indictment charging three operatives with orchestrating nearly twenty attacks across Europe and America on behalf of the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps and Kataib Hezbollah. Federal Bureau of Investigation Director Kash Patel stated the accused planned incidents including a September plot near the United Kingdom base RAF Fairford. Iran strongly rejected the allegations as malicious speculations.
articles.description: The US Department of Justice says the men were involved in a string of plots, including a major incident near the UK airbase that is used by US armed forces.

articles.headline: India and France hold dialogues on economic security and space
articles.title: India, France hold dialogues on economic security, space, technology
articles.summary: India and France convened meetings in Paris from November 9 to 10, 2026, focusing on critical technologies, supply chain security, and space cooperation. Foreign Secretary Vikram Misri and French official Martin Briens led the talks, which included preparations for an upcoming free trade agreement expected when Prime Minister Narendra Modi visits Brussels on December 16, according to the Ministry of External Affairs.
articles.description: The two sides discuss supply chain vulnerabilities, critical technologies, cybersecurity and safeguarding strategic supplies, as part of the India-France Economic Security and Critical Technologies Dialogue

articles.headline: Harry Kane scores 92nd goal as England defeats Croatia
articles.title: Nations League: Harry Kane scores for England on his record-breaking night; Italy beats France
articles.summary: Harry Kane scored his 92nd international goal from a penalty spot to secure a 2-1 victory for England against Croatia in the Nations League. The milestone match at Wembley Stadium marked Kane's record-breaking 126th appearance for his country. Elsewhere, Italy achieved a 3-1 win over France, while Spain defeated the Czech Republic 2-0.
articles.description: If England is to top the group, it will have to end Spain's 100% record in the competition and break the Spanish side’s unbeaten run that now stretches 43 matches after victory against Czech Republic

articles.headline: Israeli air strike in Gaza kills Palestinian footballer Mahmoud Kamal Abdel-Malek
articles.title: Israeli army kills Palestinian footballer Mahmoud Kamal Abdel-Malek in Gaza
articles.summary: Palestinian footballer Mahmoud Kamal Abdel-Malek was killed in an Israeli air strike on Gaza City's Sabra neighbourhood, the Palestinian Football Association confirmed. The 20-year-old goalkeeper served as captain of Gaza Sports Club and was the 1,017th sports figure killed in the conflict. His death occurred days after he competed in the Thousand Martyrs Cup. Palestinian health officials report that at least 74,645 people have died across the territory since October 7, 2023.
articles.description: Abdel-Malek, the captain and goalkeeper of Gaza Sports Club, recently played in the Thousand Martyrs Cup final.

articles.headline: Preliminary probe blames faulty braking system for Assam train derailment
articles.title: Kolkata-Sairang train derailment: Preliminary probe points to faulty braking system
articles.summary: A preliminary probe into the Kolkata-Sairang Express derailment at Digaru Railway Station in Assam indicated a malfunctioning main braking system. Investigators found the BP angle cock in the locomotive was isolated, preventing brakes from engaging. The November 11 accident occurred after the train overshot a red signal and hit a dead end.
articles.description: A six-member probe team, in its report, found that the system primarily responsible for applying brakes in the coaches, technically known as the BP angle cock, was in an isolated condition in the locomotive

articles.headline: Ousted Nvidia chief executive Jensen Huang had intimate relationship with second employee
articles.title: Former Nvidia CEO Huang had a relationship with a second employee, sources say
articles.summary: Ousted Nvidia Corporation Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang engaged in an intimate relationship with a second employee, according to sources cited by Reuters. This revelation follows two previous affairs that prompted his resignation on Thursday, involving Alice Huang and Kimberly Powell. Nvidia board appointed finance chief Colette Kress as interim chief executive while shares fell five point five percent.
articles.description: The two women so far are Alice Huang, who U.S. ‌intelligence suspects of being a Chinese spy, and Kimberly Powell, Nvidia’s vice president of health ‌care

articles.headline: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent relocated after Iran-linked threats
articles.title: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent relocated after alleged Iranian threats
articles.summary: United States Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent was moved to a military base following security concerns driven by Iran-linked threats. US media reports indicated the relocation occurred after an online photo revealed his Washington residence. US intelligence warns that efforts by Iran to target current and former American officials have escalated significantly during ongoing geopolitical tensions.
articles.description: Bessent is now one of several Trump administration officials to live on military bases due to safety concerns.

articles.headline: Keralam Governor approves prosecution of former Sports Minister Abdurahiman
articles.title: Messi visit case: Keralam Governor gives approval to prosecute former Sports Minister Abdurahiman over alleged irregularities
articles.summary: Keralam Governor Om Prakash Mathur granted sanction to prosecute former Sports Minister V. Abdurahiman under the Prevention of Corruption Act. articles.description: Lok Bhavan’s decision is based on a request of Chief Minister. The SIT led by Additional Director General of Police P. Vijayan had earlier submitted a preliminary report to the government

articles.headline: Historic SS United States ocean liner sunk to form artificial reef
articles.title: From ocean legend to undersea reef: Why has the SS United States been sunk?
articles.summary: The retired ocean liner SS United States was deliberately sunk off the coast of Destin, Florida, on Wednesday to become part of the world's largest artificial reef. Okaloosa County purchased the vessel for one million dollars in 2024 after mounting maintenance costs forced its closure. The project aims to boost marine ecosystems and local diving tourism.
articles.description: The ship had been inactive for years despite various owners attempting to save and restore it.

articles.summary: Iranian security chief Mohsen Rezaei stated in televised remarks that the Islamic Republic will keep all enriched nuclear material inside the country for naval propulsion purposes. Speaking after US officials downplayed the need for military action, Rezaei warned of retaliation against distant American bases if new strikes occur, while the International Atomic Energy Agency monitors Tehran's existing uranium stockpiles.
articles.description: Rezaei has ‌said ⁠there are currently no negotiations taking place between Tehran ⁠and Washington

articles.headline: Chris Van Hollen seeks to lead Democrats in the Senate
articles.title: US Senator Chris Van Hollen seeks to lead Democrats: Who is he?
articles.summary: Democratic Senator Chris Van Hollen of Maryland, who has served in Congress since 2003, is seeking to lead his party in the Senate. Born in Karachi, Pakistan, Van Hollen drew attention for travelling to El Salvador in April 2025 to assist a mistakenly deported resident. He has also been a prominent advocate for conditioning United States military assistance to Israel.
articles.description: Van Hollen is known for his antiwar positions and championing progressive causes.

articles.headline: Anthropic discloses complex business relationships with AI competitors
articles.title: How AI rivals are becoming investors, suppliers and customers to one another | Explained
articles.summary: Artificial intelligence firm Anthropic has revealed in a filing with the US Securities and Exchange Commission that it maintains multifaceted relationships with major technology companies. Amazon acts as an investor, infrastructure provider, and customer for Anthropic's Claude models, while simultaneously developing its own competing artificial intelligence products, highlighting the evolving and interconnected nature of the industry.
articles.description: Anthropic’s IPO filing reveals how technology companies are deepening financial and commercial ties even as they compete for the same AI market

articles.headline: Iran prepares for potential zero oil revenue amid persistent US blockade
articles.title: Can Tehran survive a ‘zero oil’ budget, if US blockade on Iran persists?
articles.summary: Tehran is bracing for a severe economic crisis as US sanctions and a naval blockade threaten to eliminate oil income. President Masoud Pezeshkian’s administration is reviewing public spending and energy subsidies to manage potential deficits. While officials deny prospects of total collapse, economists warn that replacing oil revenue remains difficult under current international financial restrictions.
articles.description: The government is defiant and planning for the worst, but a US siege is expected to make most Iranians poorer.

articles.headline: Prime Minister Modi exchanges Deepavali greetings with Sam Pitroda
articles.title: PM Modi conveys Deepavali greetings to Sam Pitroda, commends Indian media for voicing diverse opinions
articles.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi extended Deepavali greetings to Indian Overseas Congress president Sam Pitroda on November 12, 2026, following Pitroda's public remarks about their personal friendship. During a separate media event, Modi praised the Indian press for fostering diverse opinions and urged journalists to highlight national achievements while reiterating his government's goal of a developed India by 2047.
articles.description: Pitroda said a video statement on X that he might have issues with Modi’s views of the world and ideology, but his disagreement was not with the individual

articles.headline: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent relocated following alleged Iranian threats
articles.title: Bessent’s relocation: From US to EU, is Iran bringing war to Western soil?
articles.summary: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent has been moved to a military base after reports of threats linked to Iran. The relocation follows an investigation into his residence's location. Meanwhile, US forces have diverted aircraft from UK bases amid security concerns. Tehran has denied involvement in plots against officials, despite ongoing tensions over economic sanctions.
articles.description: A deliberate expansion of Iran’s campaign of retaliation beyond the Middle East could be taking place, said an expert.

articles.headline: Benjamin Netanyahu denies Israel is blocking winter aid to Gaza
articles.title: Netanyahu dismisses claims that Israel blocking supplies to Gaza
articles.summary: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu rejected claims that Israel is delaying winter supplies to Gaza, blaming Hamas for the humanitarian crisis instead. This follows reports from the U.S.-created Board of Peace that aid delays worsened conditions during severe flooding. International figures, including British Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband, have called for an end to aid restrictions.
articles.description: Benjamin Netanyahu said the Palestinian militant group Hamas is to blame because it continues to refuse to disarm, a condition of the deal announced by Donald Trump, and seizes humanitarian aid in order to use it for military purposes

articles.headline: Niraj Kumar secures quota place for 2028 Olympics with bronze medal
articles.title: Rifle shooter Niraj Kumar secures LA Olympics quota with bronze in men's 50m 3-position
articles.summary: Indian shooter Niraj Kumar won the bronze medal in the men's fifty-metre rifle three-positions event at the International Shooting Sport Federation World Championships in Doha on Wednesday, securing a quota place for the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics. Individual Neutral Athlete Dmitrii Pimenov claimed the gold medal with a world junior record score.
articles.description: It was India’s second Olympic quota at the championships, following Jaypal Malviya’s silver in the men’s 10m air pistol event a few days ago

articles.headline: German ambassador Jasper Wieck discusses India-EU Free Trade Agreement
articles.title: India-EU FTA will be a game changer, says German envoy
articles.summary: Jasper Wieck, the German Ambassador to India and Bhutan, discussed the evolving European security architecture and bilateral initiatives in an interview with Narayan Lakshman published on November 12, 2026. He highlighted the growth potential of the India-EU Free Trade Agreement as a game changer, alongside clean energy cooperation and employment opportunities for skilled Indian workers in Germany.
articles.description: ‘My focus is to enhance and deepen the strategic partnership between India and Germany and military cooperation and defence industrial cooperation play a huge role in that partnership,’ says Jasper Wieck

articles.headline: Special investigation team files first charge sheet in Veeramani POCSO case
articles.title: ‘Gem Granites’ Veeramani POCSO case: First charge sheet filed, Madras High Court told
articles.summary: A special investigation team filed the initial charge sheet against Gem Granites founder R. Veeramani before a Chennai special court under the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012. State Public Prosecutor R. John Sathyan informed the Madras High Court on November 12, 2026, that additional charge sheets will follow within fifteen days, while the judge expressed satisfaction with the ongoing investigation progress.
articles.description: Justice V. Lakshminarayanan told that the charge sheet was filed before a special court for POCSO cases in Chennai on November 11, 2026, and that the SIT intends to file multiple charge sheets in the next few days

articles.headline: Google DeepMind releases AlphaGenome 2 to predict genetic variant effects
articles.title: Google’s AlphaGenome 2 zooms in on the cellular roots of disease
articles.summary: Google DeepMind has launched AlphaGenome 2, an artificial intelligence model capable of predicting how DNA mutations influence specific cell types and states. Trained on over 100 million cell profiles, the tool identifies twice as many gene-altering variants as its predecessor. It is now available for non-commercial research to assist scientists in developing targeted medical treatments.
articles.description: Researchers at Google DeepMind have unveiled a new AI model designed to unravel how changes in our DNA affect different cells, giving scientists a more detailed view of a notoriously difficult problem that could hold important clues to the causes of disease - and point the way to new treatments. AlphaGenome 2 is the successor […]

articles.headline: Spanish court suspends far-right group Nucleo Nacional
articles.title: Spanish court suspends far-right group over alleged hate crimes
articles.summary: A judge in Gijon has suspended the activities of the far-right group Nucleo Nacional amid an investigation into hate crimes and illegal association. Authorities have blocked the group's assets and social media following the arrest of 14 members. Police also seized unlicensed firearms during raids, as the organization faces scrutiny for its anti-immigration rhetoric and political activities.
articles.description: Judge orders office shut and accounts blocked after 14 arrests and the seizure of more than 20 firearms.

articles.headline: UN climate summit promotes global electrification target amid mining concerns
articles.title: UN climate summit pushes electrification goal as groups call for mining safeguards
articles.summary: Turkiye and Australia announced a global electrification pledge during the COP31 summit aimed at increasing electricity use from 21% to 35% by 2035 to reduce greenhouse gas emissions. However, environmental groups caution that surging demand for transition minerals could escalate human rights abuses and habitat destruction. Civil society groups urge stronger safeguards, while experts note that improved recycling could significantly lower future mining requirements globally.
articles.description: The pledge builds on commitments made at previous UN climate summits: At COP28, countries agreed to work toward tripling renewable energy capacity and transitioning away from fossil fuels. COP29 focused on energy storage, grid modernisation and climate finance

articles.headline: Global leaders to gather for Bharat Summit in Hyderabad
articles.title: Leaders from nearly 70 countries to attend Bharat Summit
articles.summary: The Bharat Summit 2026 will take place in Hyderabad on November 13 and 14, hosting political leaders, diplomats, and academics from nearly 70 countries. The event aims to showcase regional development initiatives. It concludes with addresses from Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge and Lok Sabha opposition leader Rahul Gandhi, following a tour of local government landmarks.

articles.headline: Senator Chris Van Hollen challenges Chuck Schumer for leadership
articles.title: Chris Van Hollen launches bid to lead Democrats in US Senate
articles.summary: US Senator Chris Van Hollen has announced his candidacy for Senate majority leader, seeking to replace incumbent Chuck Schumer as Democrats prepare to control Congress in January. Van Hollen advocates for new leadership to address economic and political concerns, gaining support from some progressives, while Schumer maintains he has sufficient votes to continue leading the Democratic caucus.
articles.description: Van Hollen's leadership drive follows Democratic sweeps in elections and challenges veteran leader Schumer.

articles.headline: Karnataka government challenges court ruling on reservation quota increase
articles.title: Quota row: Karnataka files SLP in Supreme Court over reservation breaching 50% mark
articles.summary: The Karnataka government has filed a Special Leave Petition in the Supreme Court to contest a High Court decision that struck down increased reservation quotas for Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes. The High Court had ruled the 56% total reservation cap unconstitutional, exceeding the 50% limit established by the Supreme Court in 1992.
articles.description: The Karnataka High Court, stating that the enhancement was ‘constitutionally impermissible’, had quashed the higher reservation to SCs and STs that took it to 56 %, breaching the cap of 50% imposed by the Supreme Court in 1992

articles.headline: Argentina coach Lionel Scaloni extends contract through 2030 World Cup
articles.title: Argentina coach Lionel Scaloni renews contract to stay on for third World Cup in 2030
articles.summary: Argentina national team coach Lionel Scaloni signed a contract extension through 2030, putting him on track to become the first manager to lead La Albiceleste at three World Cups. Scaloni, who won the 2022 World Cup and two Copa America titles, will now oversee a generational transition following Lionel Messi's international retirement. Argentine Football Association president Claudio Tapia welcomed the agreement as a positive outcome for national football.
articles.description: Scaloni also confirmed that no one will wear Messi's iconic No. 10 jersey during the upcoming friendlies against Uruguay and Costa Rica — La Albiceleste's first fixtures since the star's official retirement

articles.headline: Sonam Wangchuk calls movement restrictions in Ladakh arbitrary and vague
articles.title: Restrictions on me arbitrary, vague: Sonam Wangchuk
articles.summary: Ladakh activist Sonam Wangchuk criticized restrictions that shifted him from a protest venue to his Leh residence under armed police guard. Invoking Section 163(1) of the BNSS, authorities moved him on November 11, 2026, ahead of upcoming council elections. Wangchuk stated the order is disproportionate and bad in law, noting it lacks formal house arrest phrasing while restricting his rights arbitrarily.
articles.description: The Ladakh administration shifted the activist from a protest venue to his residence in Leh and has been allegedly restrained from leaving his residence

articles.headline: US administration debates strategy regarding ongoing conflict with Iran
articles.title: Rubio backs blockade, Vance wants deal: Is Trump’s team split on Iran war?
articles.summary: Secretary of State Marco Rubio stated that current economic pressure on Iran makes further military action unnecessary, aligning with President Donald Trump's recent comments. While some officials favor continued blockades, Vice President JD Vance reportedly supports pursuing a diplomatic deal. The administration faces pressure to de-escalate following significant Republican losses in the recent midterm elections.
articles.description: Torn between military action and diplomacy, US appears to settle for drawn-out economic pressure campaign, blockade.

articles.headline: Twin cyclones devastate coastal Andhra Pradesh agriculture and livelihoods
articles.title: Twin cyclone leave livelihoods in tatters
articles.summary: Two consecutive cyclones battered coastal districts in Andhra Pradesh between October 28 and November 3, destroying thousands of acres of paddy fields and upraising coconut trees. According to the Andhra Pradesh State Disaster Management Authority, severe cyclonic storms Arnab and Murasu brought violent gales and heavy rainfall that severely impacted regions including Konaseema and West Godavari, leaving tens of thousands of farmers and fishing communities facing immense hardship.
articles.description: Cyclones, Arnab and Murasu, which hit the Andhra Pradesh coastline within a span of a week, delivered a severe blow to the fisherfolk communities, coconut and casuarina growers in West Godavari and Konaseema districts, many of whom may have to look for alternative livelihoods for two to three years, writes Nellore Sravani

articles.headline: Floods in Gaza kill four people after heavy rain submerges camps
articles.title: ‘Our neighbours are gone’: Gaza survivors recount horrors of deadly floods
articles.summary: Catastrophic flooding caused by heavy rain submerged displacement camps and destroyed cities in Gaza on Sunday, killing four people after a sandbank collapsed at the Ard al-Ribat camp in Deir el-Balah. According to the United Nations Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs, more than 26,000 households reported shelter damage, compounding severe infrastructure destruction.
articles.description: A deadly sandbank collapse buried families alive in Deir el-Balah, as survivors describe desperate rescue attempts.

articles.headline: Lebanon asks Syria to extradite suspects in former Iraqi lawmaker killing
articles.title: After Iraq ex-MP’s killing, Lebanon asks Syria to extradite suspects
articles.summary: Lebanese authorities have requested that Syria hand over two Syrian nationals suspected of involvement in the killing of former Iraqi member of parliament Ahmed al-Alwani. Preliminary findings indicate al-Alwani was strangled in a Beirut apartment, with investigators exploring a financial motive. Top prosecutor Judge Ahmed Rami al-Hajj is overseeing the ongoing inquiry by the Internal Security Forces as Iraqi officials call for a thorough investigation.
articles.description: Longtime Sunni politician and Iran critic was reportedly strangled in Beirut, sparking investigation.

articles.headline: Albania Prime Minister Edi Rama confirms 2027 NATO summit postponement
articles.title: Albania’s PM says 2027 NATO summit will not be held in Tirana
articles.summary: Albanian Prime Minister Edi Rama announced that a planned NATO summit will not take place in Tirana in 2027, citing a lack of a common alliance position on the schedule. The announcement follows reports of resistance from the United States administration over Albania's low defence spending. Domestically, Rama has faced months of protests and parliamentary disruptions over a proposed luxury resort project and university conditions.
articles.description: Albania has faced criticism over low defence spending, as Rama is under pressure at home amid months of protests.

articles.headline: Mahadev betting app kingpin remanded to judicial custody in Raipur
articles.title: Mahadev betting app kingpin sent to judicial custody till November 19
articles.summary: A special Central Bureau of Investigation court in Raipur remanded Sourabh Chandrakar to seven days of judicial custody on November 12, 2026.
